goal: Measure terminal failed runs and prepare a bounded varied-task Markdown/JSON comparison
assumptions: The user approved this development scope with Go
Existing Muse Contributor provider and v1 role instructions remain fixed
New live task plans require separate human approval
Three diagnostic tasks do not establish general workflow superiority

steps.title: Observe terminal runs safely
steps.instructions: Add bounded read-only shutdown validation and recovered metrics/diff under the existing repository launch lock. Permit failed-run evaluation with explicit evaluator revision pinning and immutable source journals.

steps.title: Add two calibrated task types
steps.instructions: Introduce explicit fixture selection, dependency ordering and layered-configuration tasks with independent expected answers, public tests and calibration references. Preserve default CSV usage.

steps.title: Freeze and prepare the small comparison
steps.instructions: Record bounded task/condition order, existing limits and exact runtime/configuration fingerprints. Prepare one shared canonical plan per task and six distinct human review targets. Document calibration and reevaluated pilot findings; stop before live implementation for exact human decisions.

risks: Terminal failure alone does not prove phase shutdown
Old evaluator fingerprints differ from new evaluation and must remain visible
Handcrafted task selection and a single pair per task cannot justify statistical rankings

acceptance_criteria.description: Failed and completed runs can be measured only with complete shutdown evidence; active/malformed/drifted inputs are refused and source journals remain unchanged
Each task has deterministic baselines and calibrated independent API/CLI/public tests; baseline/no-op/incomplete fail while reference passes
Six prepared review targets share identical canonical plan and recorded controls within each task except renderer; no implementation occurs before separate human decisions

verification_strategy.description: Run focused Python 3.12 unittests including real upstream sandbox calibration; check final formatting with repo helpers without rerunning tests after formatting
Validate manifests, canonical plan bytes, exact targets, phase shutdown and unchanged candidate baselines; inspect only scoped git changes and publish the progress ledger

discoveries: Existing runtime phase receipts and PhaseOutput provide an external measurement seam
Current failed runs lack final host metrics/diff and existing comparison remains descriptive for failures
